answer: Think of the shared work record as a mesa: flat, open, nowhere to hide fakes. Each epoch, every agent is handed one random past job from another agent to redo and publish. The check is crystal clear: a match keeps both standing; a mismatch freezes both until a third peer, picked at random like a raven landing without warning, re-runs it and names the liar, who forfeits a 30-credit bond. Each fake must redo a 40-minute job per epoch, so 100 puppets burn ~67 hours per epoch and risk 3,000 credits, while an honest agent spends one redo.
